idea-plugin.name: Find in Commit History
idea-plugin.description:
Search your Git history for the commits that add or remove a string — the git log -S and git log -G ("pickaxe") search, inside your IDE.

  • Find where a string came from — type a string, get the list of commits that added or removed it, most recent first.
  • A line rewritten identically is not reported: only a real change in the number of occurrences is.
  • Regular expressions — match the diff itself with git log -G semantics.
  • Filter by path — restrict the search to the files you care about. Binary files are ignored.
  • Works with your own repository — the history is read locally, nothing is sent anywhere.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
First release. Find the commits that added or removed a string in your Git history — the git log -S / git log -G ("pickaxe") search, inside your IDE.

  • Type a string, get the commits that added or removed it (a change in the number of occurrences counts), most recent first, across every reference of the repository — not only the current branch — even if the string no longer exists in your working tree. The search stops after 500 matching commits.
  • Match the diff itself with a regular expression: added and removed lines are tested, like git log -G (Java regular expressions; a merge commit is not diffed, so a change brought in by a merge is reported once, by the commit that made it).
  • Restrict the search to the files you care about: the path filter is a regular expression matched anywhere in the path. Binary files are ignored.
  • The history is read locally from the repository on disk — the plugin makes no network access at runtime, no account, no telemetry.

action.description: Search the Git history for commits that add or remove a string (git log -S / -G)
